summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Mark Hagler as President and Chief Commercial Officer, effective April 17, 2026. Mr. Hagler brings over 25 years of biopharmaceutical experience, including prior roles as CCO of Sun Pharmaceutical Industries and senior positions at Ipsen, Sanofi, Novartis, and Abraxis BioScience. The filing outlines his compensation will be consistent with similarly situated executives; no family relationships or reportable transactions exist. This is a voluntary, non-routine addition to senior management, flagged as a special situation.
